mapper.sql: s.id, s.teacher_id AS teacherId, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, s.course_id AS courseId, c.name AS courseName, s.class_id AS classId, cl.class_name AS className, s.start_section AS startSection, s.end_section AS endSection, ss.dict_label AS startSectionName, ss.dict_value AS startSectionValue, es.dict_label AS endSectionName, es.dict_value AS endSectionValue, CONCAT(ss.dict_label, '-', es.dict_label) AS sectionDisplay, s.day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, s.classroom, s.semester, s.year, DATE_FORMAT(s.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, DATE_FORMAT(s.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updateTime

FROM schedule s LEFT JOIN teacher t ON s.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON s.class_id = cl.id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data ss ON s.start_section = ss.dict_code AND ss.dict_type = 'sys_time_slot' LEFT JOIN sys_dict_data es ON s.end_section = es.dict_code AND es.dict_type = 'sys_time_slot'
